prompts.nookCover: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: original game cover for TUMBLE NOOK, wide landscape 3:2. Exquisite premium cosy pixel-art illustration using crisp square pixel clusters, honey wood, cream, soft sage, terracotta and deep navy shadows. A plump tiny orange-gold hamster with cream cheeks and belly, round pink-lined ears, tiny pink nose, glossy dark eyes and a small sage-green neckerchief is happily tumbling inside a square wooden dollhouse maze that is rotated playfully about 20 degrees. The maze has only a few short thick wood partitions and three large striped sunflower seeds; at right a welcoming round wicker bed with sage quilted rim and cream cushion. Under it smaller text: "ONE LITTLE TURN. ONE COSY NAP." No other text or logos, no watermark. Original character and setting, no commercial imitation.
